sheets.name: Inventory Count
sheets.notes: Count every item in the same locations each week. Extension equals Unit Cost times Count Qty. The total row gives closing or opening inventory value for the usage formula.

sheets.name: Recipe Coster
sheets.notes: One block of rows per recipe. Line Cost equals Qty times Unit Cost. Batch total is the sum of lines. Plate cost equals batch total divided by portions in cell B20. Illustrative numbers only.

sheets.name: Variance Dashboard
sheets.notes: Actual Usage equals Opening plus Purchases minus Closing. Actual FC Pct equals Usage divided by Food Sales. Variance Points equals Actual minus Theoretical. Format G and H as percent. Illustrative numbers only.

sheets.name: Waste Log
sheets.notes: Log every waste event for two full weeks. Waste Cost equals Qty times Unit Cost. The total feeds the weekly review.

sheets.name: Par Reorder
sheets.notes: Par Level equals Avg Daily Use times Lead Days plus one safety day. Order Qty equals Par minus On Hand, floored at zero. Illustrative numbers only.
